NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING The City Commission for the City of Kissimmee, Florida, Does hereby give public notice in accordance with Section 163
--- Full Notice Text --- NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING The City Commission for the City of Kissimmee, Florida, Does hereby give public notice in accordance with Section 163.346, Florida Statues of the intention to adopt a Resolution approving an amendment to update the Vine Street Community Redevelopment Plan. The City Commission will consider the resolution immediately following a public hearing to be held on November 17, 2026, beginning at 6:00 p.m. or as soon thereafter as possible at City Hall Commission Chambers, 101 Church Street, Kissimmee, Florida. The proposed Resolution may be inspected in the Office of the City Clerk at City Hall 101 N. Church Street, Kissimmee, Florida. All interested parties may appear and be heard on the above date.
A RESOLUTION OF THE VINE STREET COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY, AMENDING OR MODIFYING THE VINE STREET COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT PLAN; REAFFIRMING THE FINDING OF THE EXISTENCE OF BLIGHTED AREAS IN THE CITY, PURSUANT TO SECTION 163.355, FLORIDA STATUTES.
IN ACCORDANCE WITH FLORIDA STATUTE 286.0105: ANY PERSON WISHING TO APPEAL ANY DECISION MADE BY THE CITYCOMMISSION WITH RESPECT TO ANY MATTER CONSIDERED ATSUCH MEETING OR HEARING WILL NEED A RECORD OF THE PROCEEDINGS, AND FOR SUCH PURPOSES MAY NEED TO ENSURE THAT A VERBATIM RECORD OF THE PROCEEDINGS IS MADE, WHICH RECORD INCLUDES THE TESTIMONY AND EVIDENCE UPON WHICH THE APPEAL IS MADE.
IN ACCORDANCE WITH FLORIDA STATUTE 286.26, PERSONS NEEDING ASSISTANCE TO PARTICIPATE IN ANY OF THESE PROCEEDINGS SHOULD CONTACT THE OFFICE OF THE CITY CLERK 407-518-2308 AT 101 N. CHURCH STREET, KISSIMMEE, FL 34741, FIVE DAYS PRIOR TO THE MEETING (FS 286.26 November 5, 2026

CONTAINING 1.10 ACRES, MORE OR LESS. A copy of the proposed request may be inspected in the Development Services Department at City Hall, 101 Church Street. Any questions regarding this public hearing may be directed to the Development Services Department at (407) 518-2140. Any interested party wanting to be heard on this issue may submit testimony to be read into the official record to CityClerkEmail@kissimmee.gov prior to the start of the meeting or may be heard by participating in person. Reference # ABDN-22-0001 22-25-29-00U0-0010-0000 CITY COMMISSION KISSIMMEE, FLORIDA In accordance with Florida Statutes 286.26, persons needing assistance to participate in any of these proceedings should contact the Office of the City Clerk (407) 518-2308 prior to the meeting. (FS 286.26) In accordance with Florida Statutes 286.0105: any person wishing to appeal any decision made by the Planning Advisory Board with respect to any matter considered at such meeting or hearing will need a record of the proceedings, and for such purposes may need to ensure that a verbatim record of the proceeding is made, which record includes the testimony and evidence upon which the appeal is made. 176278 11/2/26
